decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed shop front because of its position, design and appearance. would not harm the appearance of the property or the area and complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development) and S.4.2 (Shop Front Design) of the adopted Unitary Development Plan.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The two doors shall be finished in contrasting colours to the rest of the shop front, vision panels beginning no higher than 1000mm above ground level and kicking plates no less than 400mm high shall bne incoporated
description: Installation of new shop front to create a self-contained access to existing first floor flat to retail unit.
